title: WhitelistProtocol
description: Lightweight in-game whitelisting datapack to help manage players on mid-size community servers! Created for an eSports club.
body:
Players join in spectator mode with "[Unverified]" name prefix and can't clip through blocks or go too far from worldspawn (35 blocks). Use this to set worldspawn instead of /worldspawn:
```
/function whitelist:worldspawn
```
Use this to whitelist players in-game or through console!
```
/tag [player or @a target selector] add whitelist
```
